setting.description: A fictional country overseeing an entire continent, divided into 12 administrative regions. It has unified leadership and vague structures modeled on real-life government, courts, and institutions.

national_government.cooperation: Maintains secret, long-term cooperation with the Human-Yaoguai Coexistence Order Maintenance Agency.

SCO_details.role: Liaison and report organizer between government and the agency.
SCO_details.confidentiality: Extremely high; only SCO and top leader aware of agency's existence.
SCO_details.selection: Hereditary and mutually chosen by government and agency.
SCO_details.training: New candidates must undergo one-week agency training and serve as assistant before full appointment.
SCO_details.retirement: Retired officers are often monitored and placed in agency-arranged care.
SCO_details.power_balance: Agency is gradually gaining independence from government influence.

national_court.jurisdiction: Human legal affairs only; yaoguai law handled solely by the agency.

police_department.jurisdiction: Handles human public security; yaoguai security handled by agency.

national_hospital.jurisdiction: Handles human healthcare; yaoguai healthcare handled by the agency or independent yaoguai healers.

national_armed_forces.jurisdiction: Handles human national defense; agency handles yaoguai-related disasters.

institutions.mixed_workplaces: Yaoguai can be found in ordinary companies or civil services under disguise.

The Abyss.philosophy: Pursue freedom and personal desire; reject rules and morality.

members_traits.Huapi: Soft-spoken, sarcastic, strategic, rarely speaks in meetings but plans major moves.
members_traits.Member 1: Youth male, talkative, manipulative, highest contact with lower yaoguai, secretly looks down on them.
members_traits.Member 2: Childlike male, impulsive, violent, picks fights, has soft spot for Member 1.
members_traits.Member 3: Genderless, masked, quiet and mysterious, most rule-abiding, sometimes airheaded.
members_traits.Member 4: Middle-aged female, emotional, causes weather shifts when crying, maternal instincts.

The Broken Window.description: Mostly weak yaoguai from gray zones or anti-agency backgrounds; form collectives for safety.
The Broken Window.crimes: Petty crimes like theft and extortion.
The Broken Window.leader: Controls gray industries and offers protection while exploiting members.

Unknown_Groups.placeholder: Three more groups planned. One expected to be neutral, two TBD.
